notes: Grim Tutor, printed: 'Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle. You lose 3 life.' Searching is not drawing (CR 701.23a, 121.5). The runner's opening begin_turn draws Top Junk (the turn's first draw). Grim Tutor then puts Cardinal into hand by searching: that is not a draw, so Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse ('Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 green Cat creature token') must NOT trigger. Expect Cardinal in hand, life 17, no Cat token, library down to the 6 filler cards.
